references.text: The original census of the tribe of Ephraim, which counted 40,500 men, as referenced here in the camp organization.
The second census of the tribe of Ephraim on the plains of Moab, showing the change in the tribe's size over time.
The context for Ephraim's camp on the west side of the tabernacle, where this verse is part of the description of the camp arrangement.
